about: G5 additions, merged into trophies.json at load. Steps cite sources as [@key]; the loader turns each into the trophy's numbered cite. 'disagree' lists points where sources give different versions; both are shown. Official names, descriptions and grades live only in trophies.json and are never touched here.

pms.note: PowerPyx location page (same publisher as its trophy guide): used for spot names and counts

pch.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Collectible Card Sets Locations
pch.note: PowerPyx location page (same publisher as its trophy guide): used for set names and card counts

pcd.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Delights Dancers Card Set Locations

gb.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

eg1.name: eGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies (George Tsagkarakis)

eg2.name: eGamers — GTA 6 100% Completion Guide (George Tsagkarakis)
eg2.note: Aggregator; says itself that some of its counts do not add up

lfc.name: LFCarry — GTA 6 Platinum Trophy Guide
lfc.note: Low trust: a sales page for paid boosting; cited only where it differs, and never as confirmation

supports.lfc: 15 manual save slots and one autosave

steps: Rotate manual saves rather than trusting the autosave: LFCarry counts 15 manual slots and one autosave [@lfc], and eGamers reports autosaves are rare [@eg2].

supports.lfc: places the final mission in Chapter 5

disagree.on: Which chapter holds the final mission

versions.says: PowerPyx ties this trophy and Top Of The World, Ma to the same Chapter 4 mission.
The final story mission is in Chapter 5.

supports.gb: 100% list under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, with items PowerPyx and OutputLag leave out

steps: GTABase's 100% list adds every underwater discovery, all 42 drone races, 100 optional missions and 100 of the 255 animal studies [@gb].

disagree.on: Which bank jobs the 100% list wants

versions.says: All 22 bank jobs: 14 small banks plus the 8 vaults.

supports.gb: 397 stunts split 130 / 202 / 40 / 25

steps: The 397 stunts split into 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; Progress > Activities > Stunts shows what is left [@ppx][@gb].

supports.gb: 42 golds over 12 ranges; ranges raise Focus

steps: Ranges also raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger easier later [@gb].

disagree.on: How many shooting ranges hold the 42 golds

supports.gb: Andy texts a Belville address from Chapter 3

steps: From Chapter 3, watch for Andy's text with an address in Belville: that starts the chain [@gb].

supports.gb: Kenton's Treasures tracker

steps: Your wrecks are tracked under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures [@gb].

supports.gb: strands not part of 100%
Wish List after 'Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS'; hotel driveways

steps: Hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best place to find listed cars; cleaner cars pay more [@gb].

supports.gb: names the last job 'Shut Down the Labs'

disagree.on: The name of Tyrone's last job

supports.pms: 10 spots, 18 meditations; spots 2-9 count once per character; the summit spot appears only after 17
supports.gb: balcony offered the morning after Down to Earth

steps: Spots 2-9 count once for Jason and once for Lucia; the balcony and the Mount Kalaga summit count once each: 16 + 1 + 1 = 18 [@pms].
The summit stone circle stays off the map until the other 17 are done, so skipping the balcony may leave you stuck at 16 [@pms].

The eight shared spots: Capri sandbar, Buckskin Swamp dock, Camp Moonflower, Manifest Canyon, the south Moreau water wheel, the Mount Kalaga mine tower, the falls north-west of Tallaloko, the rocks east of Waning Sands [@pms].

disagree.on: When the balcony meditation is offered

versions.says: The morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia from the kitchen.
Right after Gone Fishing, before Chapter 1 ends.

supports.gb: first hunt 'Veteran Hunted'; bring animals back alive

steps: GTABase alone says to bring the animals back alive; nobody else says so, so treat it as unconfirmed [@gb].

supports.pch: 18 sets, 480 cards, set sizes, where cards sit, variants

steps: There are 18 sets and 480 cards; the trophy needs any 3 full sets [@pch].
Smallest three by card count: Backyard Wrestling (12), Delights Dancers (18) and any 24-card set, 54 cards in all (our sum from the set list) [@pch].
If Delights Dancers is one of your three, take Vicki's card before Chapter 3 [@pcd].
Look on shelves and walls indoors, in yellow wall phone boxes and toolboxes outdoors; bronze, silver and gold variants count separately [@pch].

supports.gb: D-pad Up opens WAiNK, R1 scans

steps: Open WAiNK with D-pad Up and scan with R1 [@gb].

supports.gb: pop can lag ~30 s; rob a fourth
supports.eg1: rob a fourth if it does not pop

steps: The pop can lag about 30 seconds; if nothing comes after three, rob a fourth [@gb][@eg1].

supports.gb: a scan counts without driving

steps: A scan counts without driving the car, so a busy roadside does the job [@gb].

disagree.on: How many vehicles the game has

supports.gb: refill Focus at home; Adrenaline

steps: Fill Focus first by eating, drinking or washing up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer [@gb].

supports.gb: only jets at a boarding bridge count; gates E3/E4

steps: Only a jet at a gate's boarding bridge counts, not one parked on the airfield; gates E3 and E4 are easiest [@gb].

supports.gb: pass a bag to your partner; up to $205,000 per vault
supports.lfc: links vaults to the Cartel Heist

steps: Each vault can pay up to $205,000; bring a fast bike and swap vehicles once clear [@gb].

versions.says: The optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is...

supports.gb: a Pay 'n' Spray also ends the job

steps: Reaching a Pay 'n' Spray also counts as getting away, not only leaving the red zone [@gb].

supports.gb: gang operations show as yellow icons

steps: Gang operations show as yellow map icons [@gb].

supports.gb: not all three valuables in one visit

disagree.on: Whether all three valuables are needed

versions.says: Take all three, then lose the police.
Not all three in one visit; it pops once you lose the police.

supports.gb: the Irredeemable profile is permanent

steps: Steer clear of the Irredeemable profile while you farm: GTABase says it is permanent [@gb].

versions.says: 500 actions that shift the Criminal Profile.
Story choices made before big chapter decisions.

supports.gb: each registration costs money

steps: Each registration costs money, so cheap cars and bikes keep the bill down [@gb].
